name: Yogurt with coconut tapioca
summary: Sữa chua trân châu is cold yogurt the stall cultured, with warm coconut-milk tapioca poured over it. The coconut is sweet and rich, and the tapioca is chewy.
origin: Hạ Long. Both accounts call it a local sweet, not a recipe from another city.
taste: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls the cup cold, the coconut sweet and rich, and the tapioca chewy.
howToEat: The yogurt is soft and has no ice crystals. The tapioca is white, clear, and chewy, cut in short pieces, sitting in coconut milk the stall made. Pour the warm coconut tapioca into the cold yogurt.
VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, both printed 10,000–30,000 đồng a cup. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, repeats that range.
where: VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, gives the cup and not a street. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, names Văn Lang and Trần Quốc Nghiễn.
seoTitle: Sua chua tran chau — Ha Long yogurt and coconut tapioca
seoDescription: Sữa chua trân châu is cold cultured yogurt with warm, chewy coconut-milk tapioca.
